description: What to have ready for a signing: ID, the unsigned document, who has to be there, and what to set up for an online session. Name the document and state to also get what that state asks for (notary or witnesses) for a power of attorney, medical power of attorney, will, small estate affidavit, car title, bill of sale or apostille, with the official sources. General information, not legal advice.

document.description: The document, e.g. power of attorney, will, car title (optional)

how.description: online = by video; in_person = mobile visit (optional)

state.description: The state whose rule applies, name or two-letter code (optional)
